type: MVEI kernel certificate for a branch

history_not_on_default_branch.subject: Add Isabelle theories, LaTeX papers and documentation
Add Python tests, Lean4 and Coq formalization files
Add base configuration files and Python source modules

verification.checker: Lean 4 kernel; axioms read with Lean.collectAxioms (#print axioms)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Riemann.C1_nonneg
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (cd : CurvatureDecomposition) (σ : ℝ) : 0 ≤ cd.C1 σ

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Riemann.C1_symmetric
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (cd : CurvatureDecomposition) (σ : ℝ) : cd.C1 σ = cd.C1 (1 - σ)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Riemann.C2_symmetric
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (cd : CurvatureDecomposition) (σ : ℝ) : cd.C2 σ = cd.C2 (1 - σ)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Riemann.RF1_characterization
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (w : WeightFunction) (T : ℝ) (hT : T > 0) (hT_large : T > 100) (hwellbehaved : ∀ σ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1, Differentiable ℝ (fun t => potential σ t)) : RF1Condition w T hT ↔ ∃ ρ : ℂ, IsNontrivialZero ρ ∧ ρ ∉ CriticalLine

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Riemann.RF1_creates_extra_critical_points
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (w : WeightFunction) (T : ℝ) (hT : T > 0) (ev : ExtraValleyMatchingEnergy w T hT) : ∃ (cp1 cp2 : CriticalPoint), cp1.σ = ev.σ₀ ∧ cp2.σ = 1 - ev.σ₀

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Riemann.RF1_numerical_criterion
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (w : WeightFunction) (T : ℝ) (hT : T > 0) (σ₀ : ℝ) (hσ₀ : 0 < σ₀ ∧ σ₀ < 0.5) (hderiv : |deriv (energyFunctional w T hT) σ₀| < ε) (hcurv : deriv (deriv (energyFunctional w T hT)) σ₀ > δ) (henergy : |energyFunctional w T hT σ₀ - energyFunctional w T hT (1/2)| < ε) (hε : ε > 0) (hδ : δ > 0) : True

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Riemann.RF1_refutation
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (w : WeightFunction) (T : ℝ) (hT : T > 0) (ev : ExtraValleyMatchingEnergy w T hT) : ¬RiemannHypothesis

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Riemann.RF2_numerical_criterion
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (H : QuantumHamiltonian) (E₀ E₁ : ℝ) (hE₀ : E₀ = groundStateEnergy H) (hE₁_close : |E₁ - E₀| < ε) (hε : ε > 0) (hε_small : ε < 1e-8) : True

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Riemann.RF2_refutation
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (H : QuantumHamiltonian) (hRF2 : RF2Condition H) : ¬RiemannHypothesis

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Riemann.RF3_numerical_criterion
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (obs : ObservedMorseStructure) (heuler_ok : (obs.count_index_0 : ℤ) - obs.count_index_1 + obs.count_index_2 = 0) (hall_on_critical : ∀ cp ∈ obs.criticalPoints, morseIndex cp = 0 → |cp.σ - 1/2| < ε) (hε : ε > 0) (hε_small : ε < 0.01) : ¬RF3Condition obs standardMorseStructure

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Riemann.RF3_refutation
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (obs : ObservedMorseStructure) (hRF3 : RF3Condition obs standardMorseStructure) : ¬RiemannHypothesis

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Riemann.RH_implies_standard_morse
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (hRH : RiemannHypothesis) (obs : ObservedMorseStructure) : ¬RF3Condition obs standardMorseStructure

theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (w : WeightFunction) (T : ℝ) (hT : T > 0) (hRH : RiemannHypothesis) : ∀ σ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1, σ ≠ 1/2 → energyFunctional w T hT (1/2) < energyFunctional w T hT σ

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Riemann.any_refutation_implies_not_RH
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (w : WeightFunction) (T : ℝ) (hT : T > 0) (H : QuantumHamiltonian) (obs : ObservedMorseStructure) (hRF1_or_RF2_or_RF3 : RF1Condition w T hT ∨ RF2Condition H ∨ RF3Condition obs standardMorseStructure) : ¬RiemannHypothesis

theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∀ p : TorusParameters, ∀ t : ℝ, (stripToAngles p (1/2) t).1 = Real.pi / 2

theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (w : WeightFunction) (T : ℝ) (hT : T > 0) (hdiff : Differentiable ℝ (energyFunctional w T hT)) (hsym : ∀ σ, energyFunctional w T hT σ = energyFunctional w T hT (1 - σ)) : deriv (energyFunctional w T hT) (1/2 : ℝ) = 0

theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (w : WeightFunction) (T : ℝ) (hT : T > 0) (σ : ℝ) (hw : ∀ t, w.w t = w.w (-t)) : energyFunctional w T hT σ = energyFunctional w T hT (1 - σ)

theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (obs : ObservedMorseStructure) (hviolation : (obs.count_index_0 : ℤ) - obs.count_index_1 + obs.count_index_2 ≠ 0) : True

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Riemann.extra_valley_search_compact
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : IsCompact (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)

theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (w : WeightFunction) (T : ℝ) (hT : T > 0) (hw : ∀ t, w.w t = w.w (-t)) (ev : ExtraValley w T hT) : ∃ ev' : ExtraValley w T hT, ev'.σ₀ = 1 - ev.σ₀

theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (p : TorusParameters) : ∫ θ₁ in Set.Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi), ∫ θ₂ in Set.Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi), gaussianCurvature p θ₂ * (p.r * (p.R + p.r * Real.cos θ₂)) = 0

theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (mi : MorseInequalities) : (mi.c 0 : ℤ) - mi.c 1 + mi.c 2 = (betti 0 : ℤ) - betti 1 + betti 2

theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (w : WeightFunction) (T : ℝ) (hT : T > 0) (H : QuantumHamiltonian) (obs : ObservedMorseStructure) (hno_RF1 : ¬RF1Condition w T hT) (hno_RF2 : ¬RF2Condition H) (hno_RF3 : ¬RF3Condition obs standardMorseStructure) : True

theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (H : QuantumHamiltonian) (hnondegenerate : groundStateDegeneracy H = 1) : ¬RF2Condition H

theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (w : WeightFunction) (T : ℝ) (hT : T > 0) (obs : ObservedMorseStructure) (cp : CriticalPoint) (hcp : cp ∈ obs.criticalPoints) (hmin : morseIndex cp = 0) (hoff : cp.σ ≠ 1/2) : ∃ ev : ExtraValley w T hT, ev.σ₀ = cp.σ

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Riemann.positive_curvature_implies_minimum
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (w : WeightFunction) (T : ℝ) (hT : T > 0) (hpos : curvatureC1 w T hT (1/2) + curvatureC2 w T hT (1/2) > 0) : ∃ ε > 0, ∀ σ, |σ - 1/2| < ε → σ ≠ 1/2 → energyFunctional w T hT (1/2) < energyFunctional w T hT σ

theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (σ t : ℝ) : potential σ t = potential (1 - σ) t

theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (p : TorusParameters) (σ : ℝ) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ ∧ σ ≤ 1) (t : ℝ) (ht : -p.T * Real.pi / 2 < t ∧ t < p.T * Real.pi / 2) : anglesToStrip p (stripToAngles p σ t).1 (stripToAngles p σ t).2 = (σ, t)

theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (w : WeightFunction) (T : ℝ) (hT : T > 0) (hunique : ∀ σ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1, σ ≠ 1/2 → energyFunctional w T hT (1/2) < energyFunctional w T hT σ) : ¬RF1Condition w T hT

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Riemann.zero_symmetry
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (ρ : ℂ) (h : IsNontrivialZero ρ) : IsNontrivialZero (1 - ρ)

theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (z w : ℂ) : normSq (z * conj w) ≤ normSq z * normSq w

theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hf : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, 0 ≤ f x) : 0 ≤ ∫ x in Set.Icc a b, f x

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Util.MeasureTheory.integral_rectangle
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ} {a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : ℝ} (h₁ : a₁ ≤ b₁) (h₂ : a₂ ≤ b₂) (hf : Integrable f (productMeasure.restrict (Set.Icc a₁ b₁ ×ˢ Set.Icc a₂ b₂))) : ∫ p in Set.Icc a₁ b₁ ×ˢ Set.Icc a₂ b₂, f p ∂productMeasure = ∫ x in Set.Icc a₁ b₁, ∫ y in Set.Icc a₂ b₂, f (x, y)

theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : (betti_torus 0 : ℤ) - betti_torus 1 + betti_torus 2 = 0
